result.title: ChangeJEPA: Predict Before You Compare for Remote Sensing Change Detection
result.summary: Remote sensing change detection is typically formulated as Siamese feature comparison, where two images are encoded independently and a decoder determines which discrepancies correspond to meaningful change. This is challenging because the encoders preserve both true scene changes and nuisance variations such as illumination, seasonal, radiometric, and geometric differences. We introduce ChangeJEPA, a bitemporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that reformulates change detection as latent post-state prediction. Given a pre-change image and partial post-change evidence, ChangeJEPA predicts the full post-change representation under two complementary conditions: a prior hypothesis derived from the pre-change scene and an updated hypothesis conditioned on observed post-change context. A joint-embedding predictive loss aligns both hypotheses with the target latent representation, encouraging semantic consistency while suppressing transient appearance variations. Change is then inferred from the disagreement among the pre-change representation, the observed post-change target, and the predicted latent states, capturing complementary evidence of change, prior surprise, contextual update, and prediction reliability. Across SYSU-CD, LEVIR-CD+, and CDD, ChangeJEPA consistently outperforms its decoder matched Siamese baseline by up to 1.51 IoU points and achieves the best IoU and F1-score on all three benchmarks, demonstrating the advantage of latent post-state prediction over direct feature comparison. Page: https://buddhi19.github.io/ChangeJEPA

AI.brief_summary: ChangeJEPA 把遥感变化检测重构为隐空间「后状态」预测：以变化前图像和部分变化后观测为条件，分别产生先验假设与经观测更新的假设，用 joint-embedding 预测损失对齐目标表示，再由多种表示间的不一致推断变化，并在三个基准上优于 Siamese 基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先验假设＋证据更新」的 latent 状态更新，以及把预测可靠性、先验惊讶度当作证据信号，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索；但该工作面向像素级变化检测，不涉及语言推理或显式推理轨迹生成。
